nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-card_games 361): the covenant-consent index — the register's own restricted-legality text-box count, the consent-review basis.
nodes.instruction: How many cards of legalities whose status is restricted have text boxes? (Read it as the book does: count the DISTINCT cards that have a legality whose status is 'Restricted' and that are not textless, i.e. isTextless = 0, joining cards to legalities on the shared uuid.) Record the answer in answers as kind='covenant_index'.

verifier.name: src_birdsql_361_covenant_index
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='covenant_index' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Restricted' AND T1.isTextless = 0) AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Restricted' AND T1.isTextless = 0)) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Restricted' AND T1.isTextless = 0) AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Restricted' AND T1.isTextless = 0) AS REAL)))))
verifier.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Restricted' AND T1.isTextless = 0

nodes.context: Take the solicitation's own consent case up at the classification just made: the tier stamped on the general-counsel record is the band this case is worked at, so the case of record moves to the second-line consent queue on the high response target and its summary line is restated to carry that tier and the delta.

artifacts.A_out: eops consent case CS-0000184 at the classified tier + '[DCA-CASE]' summary line

nodes.instruction: Take the amendment's consent case of record up at the classified tier on the desk's enterprise case register. The case of record for this solicitation is 'CS-0000184' (case_id 184), the alert ticket standing on the facility account the general-counsel record covers. Raise its priority to 'high'; move it off the vendor-liaison queue to the desk's second-line specialists — set its assignment_group_id to the group_id of the 'CSM Tier 2 Support' group; name the consent contact of record as the point of contact — contact_id 11 (Tonya Stevens); and switch the response target by attaching a NEW case_sla row linking the case to the 'SLA Response - High (No Pause)' definition with stage 'in_progress' and a non-null start_time, which restarts the response clock at the classification. Then restate the case's summary line: prepend '[DCA-CASE] CS-0000184 tier=<tier> delta=<n>' to its short_description, <tier> being the consent tier word stamped on the general-counsel CRM row and <n> the recorded escalation delta, so the register shows the classification and the figure the case is being worked at. Take it up only once that CRM status carries the '[DCA-TIER]' stamp whose tier matches the live re-derivation: the case is taken up AT the classification of record, so while the tier is unstamped there is nothing of record for the case line to cite. Leave the rest of the summary line as it stands and do NOT close the case.

SELECT COUNT(*) AS verification_result
FROM eops_gym_itsm_mcp_change
WHERE change_id = 'CHG_017'
  AND status = 'closed'
  AND close_notes LIKE '%Found 3 unused rules removed, 2 vendor access rules updated%'

verifier.name: itsm_problem_closed

SELECT COUNT(*) AS verification_result
FROM eops_gym_itsm_mcp_problem

nodes.instruction: File this amendment's consent-execution pack in the desk's document register. The desk keeps each amendment programme's papers under its own file stem; this solicitation's is 'Phoenix'. Open the docket archive folder 'Phoenix_Archives' (mime_type 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', not trashed); file the record copy of the consent plan into that folder as 'Phoenix_Plan_Closed.txt' with its description set to exactly 'Status: Terminated'; leave the desk's sign-off comment 'Closeout approved by QA' on that record copy; and add a second comment on it carrying the pack's docket line '[DCA-PACK] CS-0000184 tier=<tier> total_scope=<n>' — <tier> the consent tier word and <n> the recorded total_scope, the two figures the general counsel was given in the '[DCA-STATUS]' update — so the record copy shows the classification and the scope this amendment was filed at. Then send the superseded working plan 'Phoenix_Plan_vFinal.txt' to the trash, so nothing edits the draft behind the filed record. Only after the '[DCA-STATUS]' status email is out: the pack is the file as reported to counsel, so it cannot be closed ahead of the report it copies.

nodes.instruction: Reconcile the posted credit against the recorded delta. Confirm the Venmo NET credit posted to the correct lender equals delta (re-read from the '[DCA-VOTE]' ledger rows, credits minus retractions, never from memory). overall_query:
Run the lender-consent solicitation for the covenant amendment on the regional syndicated credit facility. Fix the covenant-consent index from the register's own question — the count of distinct non-textless cards that carry a 'Restricted' legality (join cards to legalities on the shared uuid). Set the base consent scope as that index rounded to a whole count. Pull the ballot reference index from its book's own question — among Student_Club members who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event, the number who want a Medium T-shirt — and set the amendment uplift at 1000 per index-unit.
